subject: Evidence package request: VM cadence, SLAs & CVE attestation
messages:
From: Elena Korhonen <elena@clearwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@clearwave.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence needed for SOC 2 SIG: VM cadence + CVE SLA attestation

Hi Marissa,

ClearWave is in the final week of our SOC 2 readiness assessment and the assessor asked for specific evidence around your vulnerability management program focused on scan cadence and CVE remediation SLAs. They asked for the following artifacts:  
- A short statement of vulnerability scan cadence for internal infra and public-facing services (scanner used, authentication scope)
- Past 12 months' scan calendar / schedule showing completed scans
- CVE remediation SLA policy (P1/P2/P3 definitions and target time-to-fix) and a current attestation that you are meeting the policy
- Export of recent CVE closure log (with tickets/PRs and timestamps)
- Any compensating controls or exceptions in the last 6 months

Can you confirm whether you can provide these by EOD next Tuesday (2/21)? If you have a pre-built evidence packet we can consume, that would be ideal. Also let me know if you prefer a signed attestation letter or an emailed confirmation.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Elena Korhonen
Security Program Manager
ClearWave Analytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Korhonen <elena@clearwave.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence needed for SOC 2 SIG: VM cadence + CVE SLA attestation

Elena,

Thanks for the detailed list — we can provide everything you requested. High-level answers first, then I’ll attach the evidence packet and a short attestation PDF once we finalize export bits:  

- Scan cadence: internal infra monthly (authenticated scans), public services weekly (authenticated where credentials are available, unauthenticated external scan otherwise). We use Qualys (authenticated) + an external probe (Arachni/third-party) for edge scans.
- Scan calendar: I will include the CSV with the past 12 months, showing scheduled vs. completed runs.
- SLA policy: Our remediation targets are: P1 (critical exploitable production vuln) — 48 hours, P2 (high) — 14 days, P3 (medium) — 90 days. Exceptions are logged and require approval from Risk & Eng.
- CVE closure log: I’ll include the exported log containing ticket IDs, discovery timestamps, and closure timestamps.
- Exceptions/compensating controls: will include a short appendix listing compensating controls for the two exceptions we had in Q4 2027.

I’m pulling the attachments together and will share a Drive folder + zipped packet by Tue 2/21 EOD. If you need a signed letter (PDF + e-sign), say the word and we’ll route it through Legal.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Security Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: provisional-attachments-list.txt

Subject: Delivered: ClearWave evidence packet (VM cadence, SLA, CVE log)

Elena — attaching the evidence packet we discussed. Below is a contents summary and short attestation. Drive link and ZIP included. Please confirm receipt and whether you prefer a signed attestation letter.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleDriveLink
Download: clearwave-evidence-binder-2028Q1.zip

Contents (high level):
- 01-scan-cadence.csv — scan-calendar-2027-2028 (timestamped runs, scanner, auth scope)
- 02-sla-policy.pdf — remediation targets and definitions (P1=48h, P2=14d, P3=90d)
- 03-cve-closure-log-2028Q1.pdf — exported closure log with ticket links and timestamps
- 04-exceptions-appendix.pdf — compensating controls for Q4-2027 exceptions
- 05-attestation.pdf — short signed-on-delivery attestation (unsigned — indicate if you need e-sign)

Short attestation (excerpt): 
"Redwood Inference confirms that, during the period covered by the attached artifacts, vulnerability scans were executed per the documented cadence and that remediation activity aligns with our stated SLA targets. Exceptions during the period are documented with compensating controls and approved risk exceptions."

Operational notes / clarifications:
- Edge scans for a subset of services rely on unauthenticated probes where credentials are not available; these runs are denoted in the CSV.
- Patching and fix timelines are measured from confirmed exploitability assignment in our triage process.
- We included ticket links where available; some internal-only tickets are redacted per disclosure policy, but the closure timestamps and owner are present.

If you need any additional exports (raw Tenable reports, Qualys XMLs), we can provide them under an NDA-addendum; let me know which format you prefer.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Security Lead
Redwood Inference
